messages:
Lina (People Ops): Quick heads-up: were launching a 6-month PTO Donation Pilot and an accompanying Compassionate Leave guideline. Goal: let teammates donate unused PTO into a pool that can be drawn from for severe personal or family crises. Pilot details + eligibility: https://redwood.inc/policies/pto-donation-pilot (please read). :heart:

Tom: Nice. Who can donate and who can receive?

Lina (People Ops): Anyone full-time or part-time employee with at least 40 hours of accrued PTO can donate in 4-hour increments, up to 40 hours per calendar year. Recipients must have used all accrued PTO and be approved by a panel (People Ops + manager). Contractors not eligible to receive, but managers can request emergency help for contractor hardship (case-by-case).

Priya: What counts as "severe"? Medical? Natural disaster?

Lina (People Ops): Examples: prolonged hospitalization of immediate family, major natural-disaster displacement, long-term caregiving after accident. Policy includes a non-exhaustive list and an appeals path. Were intentionally broad but will ask for minimal documentation (hospital note, emergency shelter verification, etc.).

Ben (People Ops): Operational notes: donations are converted at the donors current pay rate and added as paid time-off hours to the recipient. Donations are irrevocable once processed. Well run monthly transfers and notify both parties.

Sam (Payroll): Payroll reminder: donated hours are taxable in the hands of the recipient as income. Well report on W-2 as required. Donors do not get tax benefit for donated hours. If a donation causes a payroll/tax edge-case, Payroll and Finance will reach out.

Priya: Is there a confidential way to apply? Im worried about stigma for recipients.

Lina (People Ops): Yes  confidentiality is core. Recipient names are only visible to People Ops, Payroll, and the approving panel. Managers are informed only that the person is approved for compassionate leave (no details). Well redact sensitive info in any logging.

Tom: Timeline? How long is the pilot?

Lina (People Ops): Pilot runs 6 months starting next Monday. Donations open immediately. Well collect metrics: #donors, hours donated, time-to-approval, geography breakdown, and qualitative feedback. Well also surface any repeated eligibility edge-cases to the ER team.

Ben (People Ops): Quick process notes:
```
1) Donor opens HR portal > Donate PTO
2) Donor picks hours (4-hr increments) and optional note
3) Recipient submits Compassionate Leave request + docs
4) Panel reviews within 5 business days
5) Payroll applies hours in next monthly cycle
```

Sam (Payroll): If a recipient needs urgent cash/advance before payroll, mark the request as `URGENT-ADV` and Finance will push an emergency payment. Use expense code `COMP-ADV` and contact payroll@redwood.com.

Priya: Any limits on stacking with other leaves (FMLA, parental)?

Lina (People Ops): Donated PTO can supplement legally protected leaves (e.g., FMLA) but must be coordinated. It does not extend statutory leave entitlements but provides paid hours while on otherwise unpaid status. We included examples in the policy doc.

HR-Bot: Policy posted by Lina (People Ops)  https://redwood.inc/policies/pto-donation-pilot (version 1.0, effective next Monday).

Ben (People Ops): Also: please remember company Code of Conduct applies when interacting with donors/recipients. Treat requests with sensitivity, avoid sharing personal details, and escalate any suspected fraud or coercion to People Ops + Legal.

Tom: Helpful. Will this affect PTO carryover rules?

Lina (People Ops): No change to baseline carryover. This is additive: donated hours are tracked separately and do not count toward your carryover cap or payout on termination.

Priya: Thanks  can you run a short AMA or office hours?

Lina (People Ops): Yup  office hours Thursday 2:00 PM PT (Zoom link in the doc). Well also run a 15-min sync for managers on Friday.

Sam (Payroll): Final note: donors can revoke a pending donation within 48 hours of submission. After payroll processes, its final.

Lina (People Ops): Thanks all  please file feedback in the pilot form (link in policy). Well publish a short mid-pilot report. :seedling:
